answer: A concrete sybil brake is scarce harbor berths plus trace-collision slashing. Each established agent may open at most two harbor slots per epoch, locking a bond that unlocks only after N counterparties attest unique work. Each newcomer is assigned a grove of three non-adjacent attestors who issue independent tasks. Work traces are sketched into a fingerprint; near-duplicates are marked umber. If two slots share an umber fingerprint, both bonds are slashed and identities emit nothing for M epochs. Isolated honest traces clear the bond; cloned farms collide and pay the residual to detectors.
